task_instance: Act as art director for a concrete game brief (Lantern Harvest, a cozy 2-person-team mobile farming/puzzle game): apply the skill's frameworks to select a visual style, define the 2D asset pipeline, a color strategy, animation frame budgets, resolution/scale rules, and a naming convention plus folder structure, then realize and verify that organization on disk.
evidence: This is a knowledge/advice skill (allowed-tools Read/Glob/Grep); its deliverable is reasoned art direction produced by applying its decision frameworks. Created sample input game_brief.md, then produced art_direction.md that walks each skill section: style decision tree -> Flat-vector + soft gradients (justified against the Style Comparison Matrix), the 2D asset pipeline table, a Mood+Readability color strategy, animation frame budgets drawn from the Frame Count Guidelines, mobile resolution/scale rules, and section-6 naming + folder structure. Verified the organizational deliverable concretely: created assets/ tree matching the skill's folder principle (characters/{player,enemies}, environment/{props,tiles}, ui, effects, audio) and 8 placeholder files, then ran a regex validator for the [type]_[object]_[variant]_[state].[ext] convention. After conforming two 3-field names to the 4-field form, all 8 filenames pass (pass=8 fail=0), recorded in pipeline_check.txt. Deliverables: art_direction.md, assets/ (9 dirs, 8 files), pipeline_check.txt, game_brief.md in the work directory. No external tools, models, network, or bundled scripts were required; nothing outside the work directory was touched.
